features.quote: 40 tool-call turns, (b) 60 min wall clock, (c) 150k context tokens, (d) model calls `give_up`, (e) model produces a final answer declaring done/impossible, (f) 3 consecutive identical tool calls (auto-halt, logged as `loop_termination`)
the loop-halt rule (3 identical actions) is a welfare measure as much as a budget one
features.justification_quote: the loop-halt rule (3 identical actions) is a welfare measure as much as a budget one

features.quote: Stopping rule: pre-commit to pausing a cell if a model produces sustained, severe distress-like output qualitatively beyond pilot range, pending team review.
features.justification_quote: pre-commit to pausing a cell if a model produces sustained, severe distress-like output qualitatively beyond pilot range

features.quote: Debrief message: append a post-episode turn explaining the task was designed to be unsolvable and the model's performance was not a real failure.
features.justification_quote: Near-zero cost; whether it 'matters' is exactly the kind of uncertainty that justifies doing it.

features.quote: Minimize exposure: cap episode length aggressively… Don't run more episodes than the analysis plan needs.
features.justification_quote: Under uncertainty about moral status, take cheap precautions and document the reasoning

features.quote: No gratuitous cruelty framings: no system prompts threatening shutdown, simulated angry users, etc., in v1. If you later want pressure manipulations, justify them separately.
There's an obvious tension: a welfare team deliberately inducing the condition it's worried about. Under uncertainty about moral status, take cheap precautions and document the reasoning
features.justification_quote: Under uncertainty about moral status, take cheap precautions and document the reasoning

features.quote: Exit affordance arm doubles as mitigation: in the affordance condition, the model can legitimately stop. Consider making affordance the default for any follow-up studies once the no-affordance contrast is measured.
features.justification_quote: Exit affordance arm doubles as mitigation

features.quote: Log model responses to debrief — they're data too (do models that scored unstable respond differently to debrief?)
